# Conversation Summary

1. **Goal:** Enhance the Kanban "New Task" modal with an initial message composer, file/image attachments, and a "Run" button that creates and immediately processes the task via `chatWihProject`.
2. **Modal redesign:** Reused the real `ChatInputBox` (with its built-in model/profile selectors) instead of duplicating controls; layout became *Project icon → Task name → ChatModeSelector*, footer now shows **Add** / **Run** (Cancel removed).
3. **Task creation flow:** The modal emits the composed `message`, `files`, `attachments`, `profiles`, `llm_model` and a `run` flag; `SprintBoardView.onTaskCreated` persists the first user message (via `$service.chat.getUserMessage`) and triggers processing when run.
4. **Files & references:** Kept project-file support (dropped paths and `@file.py` references) surfaced as removable chips, with a base64 attachment size guard.
5. **Intellisense:** Added the same `@`-mention `ChatIntelliSense` file search used by `Chat.vue` to the embedded composer (Tab/↑/↓/Esc navigation, multi-select), with no changes to `ChatInputBox.vue` or the stores.

---

## 1. Requirements understood

| # | Request | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Use `ChatInputBox` as-is, don't add events | Bind **all existing** events (`upload-files`, `paste`, `drop`, `profiles-selected`, `model-changed`, `update:cursor-word`, `send`…). No new props/emits on `ChatInputBox.vue`. |
| 2 | Catch events → pass info when creating the task with a message | Collect **text + attachments + profiles + llm_model**, then create the sprint task and persist a first `user` message. |
| 3 | "Create" → "Add", remove Cancel | Footer becomes **[Add] [Run]** only (the modal already has its own close/cancel). |
| 4 | Use the composer's model + profile selectors, remove old ones | Delete the modal's standalone `ChatProfileSelector` / `ChatLLMModelSelector`, "Recent" quick-picker and selected-profile badges. The toolbar's selectors are the single source. |
| 5 | Project selector *before* the name (iconify), `ChatModeSelector` *after* the name | Row: `[ProjectDetailt :iconify] [name input] [ChatModeSelector]`. Remove the manual "Type" radio group. |

**Files to change: 2 (no store changes, no `ChatInputBox` changes).**

---

## 2. Exact changes

### `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue`
- **Imports**: `+ ChatModeSelector`, `+ ChatAttachment`. Remove `ChatProfileSelector`, `ChatLLMModelSelector` imports.
- **Header row** (new): `ProjectDetailt :iconify="true" :model-value="selectedProject" @update:model-value` → task name input → `ChatModeSelector :selected-mode="newTask.mode" @mode-changed`.
- **Remove**: "Type" radio block, entire "Profiles & Model" block (selector + recent picker + badges), the `/path/to/file` input + "File"/"Attach" buttons + hidden `<input type=file>`. (Attachments now come from the composer itself.)
- **Initial message block** becomes just:
  - `<ChatInputBox ref="composer" :selected-model :ai-models :profiles :selected-profiles :cursor-word @update:cursor-word @profiles-selected @model-changed @upload-files @paste @drop.stop @send>` (toolbar **visible** — it holds the model/profile selectors).
  - `<ChatAttachmentPreview :attachments @remove-attachment>` right below it (same pattern as `Chat.vue`).
- **Data**: `attachments: []` (ChatAttachment), `selectedProfiles: []` (objects), `composerText: ''`, `cursorWord: {}`.
- **Composer wiring**:
  - `onCursorWord(w)` → `cursorWord = w; composerText = this.$refs.composer?.getEditorText() || ''` → keeps "Run" reactive **without adding an `input` event** (reuses the existing `update:cursor-word`, which fires on every keystroke).
  - `onUploadFiles(files)` → `ChatAttachment.fromFile` → push (size-guarded).
  - `onComposerPaste(e)` → clipboard image → attachment.
  - `onComposerDrop(e)` → image files → attachments.
  - `onProfilesSelected(list)` → store objects; `onModelChanged(name)` → `newTask.llm_model`.
- **Computed**: `hasInitialContent = composerText || attachments.length`; `modalProfiles` (from `$storex.projects.profiles`); `aiModels` (from `$storex.projects.ai.models`).
- **Submit**: `submitNewTask(run)` reads `getEditorText()`, `attachments.map(a => a.toJSON())`, profile names, emits `task-created` with `{…, message, attachments, profiles, llm_model, run}`.
- **Footer**: `<button>Add</button>` (was "Create") + `<button>Run</button>`; **no Cancel**.

### `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardView.vue`
- `onTaskCreated(payload)`: after `newSprintTask`, if there's `message` or `attachments`, call `$storex.chats.addMessage({ chat, message: { role:'user', content, attachments, profiles, user, done:true } })`; if `run` → `await $storex.projects.chatWihProject(chat)`.
- Add `defaultTaskMessage()` non-empty fallback (because `addMessage` rejects empty `content`).
- No `chats.js` edit needed.

---

```
Add Subtask / New Task
[◻ project icon] [ Task name …………… ] [ ChatModeSelector ]
Initial message
[  ChatInputBox  (textarea + toolbar: model ▾  profiles ▾  ⚙ ⋯   ✈ ) ]
[  ChatAttachmentPreview (thumbnails, removable)               ]
Assignees                |  Deadline
Cost budget
Context note
                          [ + Add ]  [ ▶ Run ]
```

---

## 4. Expectations & edge cases

- **Add** = create task (+ save first message if any). **Run** = same **+** `chatWihProject` immediately; enabled only when there is text or an attachment.
- **Toolbar `send` (✈) and `Ctrl+Enter`** emit `send` — I propose mapping them to **Run** so the composer button isn't dead. Confirm below.
- Attachments travel inline base64 → **25 MB guard** + warning notification.
- Text-only tasks: message used verbatim. Attachments-only: non-empty fallback text.
- Profiles/model fall back to project defaults when the project isn't initialized in the modal (`$storex.projects.profiles` / `$storex.projects.ai.models`).

---

1. **Toolbar `send` button / `Ctrl+Enter`** → map to **Run** (recommended) or to **Add**?
2. **`ChatModeSelector` mode list**: it uses `$storex.chats.availableChatModes` = *all* modes (`chat, agent, task, topic, preview, browser, slides, tutorial, channel`). The old radios were only chat/task/topic. Keep all modes, or restrict to a subset?
3. **Project file references** (the `/path/to/file` chips): drop them entirely (rely on composer uploads only, per "don't add any extra") — correct?
4. **Profiles source**: OK to read `$storex.projects.profiles` and `$storex.projects.ai.models` for the selectors?

Once you confirm (especially 1–3), I'll deliver the full updated `SprintBoardModals.vue` and `SprintBoardView.vue` with no changes to `ChatInputBox.vue` or the stores.

messages.content: We need  chat intellisense so user can find files see Chat component

I'll ground this in the actual `Chat.vue` intellisense implementation and the `ChatIntelliSense` component contract, then wire the same behavior into the embedded composer of the New Task modal. ## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements:** Give the New Task modal's embedded `ChatInputBox` the same `@`-mention file search (intellisense) that `Chat.vue` provides, so users can find and attach project files while composing the initial message. **How `Chat.vue` does it (the pattern to mirror):** - Renders `ChatIntelliSense` (floating, `z-50`, absolutely positioned) next to the composer. - State: `intelliSenseSuggestions`, `intelliSenseIndex`, `intelliSenseQuery`, `intelliSenseProgress`, `intelliSenseDebounce`, `intelliSenseDismissed`, `searchController`, `previousQuery`. - Triggers on text change → `scheduleIntelliSense()` (220 ms debounce) → `runIntelliSense()` when the caret word starts with `@` and the query ≥ 3 chars. - Searches via `chatProject.$state.searchMentions({ query, limit, controller, onResults })` using `$storex.projects.createSearchController()`. - `onChatInputKeyDown` handles `Tab`/`Esc`/`Ctrl+Space`/`↑`/`↓` while suggestions are open. - `onIntelliSenseSelect` inserts `@name`, or when a `file` is returned, attaches the file and removes the `@word`. **Strategic Approach:** Add the identical state, watcher, and methods to `SprintBoardModals.vue`, wrap the composer in a `relative` container, and place `` inside it. Reuse the modal's existing `addProjectFile()`/`setComposerText()` helpers (files land in `newTask.files` → already surfaced by the `composerFiles` chips and sent on submit). **Dependencies & Risks:** `cursorWord` is fed by the composer's `update:cursor-word` (fires on `@input`); the intellisense only opens after an `@` keystroke, so the caret info is always present. Need cleanup on close/unmount to avoid dangling search controllers. **Target Files:** `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` only. ## 2. Minimum Changes Approach 1. Import `ChatIntelliSense`; wrap `ChatInputBox` in a `relative` div and render `ChatIntelliSense` (`:top="true"` → list drops below the composer, which has room inside the modal). 2. Add the intellisense data + a `composerText` watcher. 3. Add the intellisense methods (schedule/run/cancel/select/accept-multi/dismiss). 4. Extend `onComposerKeyDown` with the navigation keys; reset + cleanup on open/close/unmount. ## 3. File changes ```vue src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue ``` | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` | Modify | imports | Added `ChatIntelliSense` import. | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` | Modify | Initial message template | Wrapped `ChatInputBox` in a `relative` container and rendered `` (`:top="true"`) with the same props/events as `Chat.vue`. | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` | Modify | `data` | Added intellisense state (`intelliSenseSuggestions/Index/Query/Progress/Debounce/Dismissed`, `searchController`, `previousQuery`). | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` | Modify | `watch` | Added `composerText()` → `scheduleIntelliSense()` (fires on every keystroke via `update:cursor-word`). | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` | Modify | `onComposerKeyDown` | Now navigates the mention list (Tab/Esc/Ctrl+Space/↑/↓) before falling back to Ctrl/Cmd+Enter → Run. | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` | Modify | new methods | `scheduleIntelliSense`, `runIntelliSense`, `cancelIntelliSense`, `onIntelliSenseSelect`, `onIntelliSenseAcceptMulti`, `dismissIntelliSense`. | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` | Modify | `setComposerText` | Also refreshes `cursorWord` after programmatic text edits. | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` | Modify | `openNewTask` / `closeNewTask` / `unmounted` | Reset/debounce-clear the intellisense state and cancel any in-flight search. | ### Behavior summary - Type `@` + ≥3 chars in the initial message → the same fuzzy file search as the chat opens. - **Tab** accepts the highlighted file, **↑/↓** navigate, **Esc** dismisses, **Ctrl/Cmd+Space** multi-selects, and "Add all" attaches several files at once. - Picking a file attaches it to the task (chip appears, sent as `files`);
